data.domain: public Payments repository and provider topology

data.summary: Create the public dinkuskit/payments repository and reserve @dinkuskit/payments with EmDash plugin ID dinkus-payments. Document that Commerce owns authoritative amount, checkout, attempt, order, receipt, and the provider port; Payments owns server-side provider selection, processor adapters, Stripe transport, webhook verification, and normalized results. Allow exactly one active provider per store, implement only Stripe for the demo, reject unknown providers with no fallback or browser selection, allow USD only using integer minor units plus currency, and defer other currencies. The initial source is a verified non-operational scaffold with no Stripe SDK, credentials, live payment calls, publishing, deployment, Commerce changes, template-store changes, inventory changes, or shipping work.

data.domain: Merchant-owned Stripe connection from the registry Payments plugin

data.summary: Implement the first local hosted Payments connection slice: merchant-owned Stripe accounts, DinkusKit-hosted service and shared merchant identity, authenticated immutable store/account binding, resumable Stripe-hosted onboarding, authoritative readiness and a fail-closed checkout binding. Verify retries, interrupted setup, account isolation and readiness regression. Preserve Stripe-only, USD-only and Commerce ownership of checkout, attempts, orders and receipts. Consume the in-progress Commerce payment binding contract without editing its worktree. Registry installation remains the delivery target; public account sign-in, live credentials, deployment and live payment activation are not authorized by this local implementation.

data.next_safe_action: Implement the shared DinkusKit account service and registry client against docs/hosted-connections.md; then complete Stripe test proof and verified-route review.
data.reason: First local backend slice is tested; registry/account integration and authorized review remain outstanding.

data.domain: Stripe hosted Checkout Sessions adapter for Commerce

data.summary: Implement Payments-owned Stripe hosted Checkout Sessions against Commerce CheckoutPaymentPort: immutable merchant binding, card-only USD integer minor units, one durable operation per attempt and original 30-minute window. ensureSession and authoritative read-only lookup preserve unknown after ambiguous responses or finite idempotency expiry; webhooks verify raw bytes before use and only wake reconciliation. Existing payment reconciliation bypasses new-checkout readiness. Test replay, mismatch, concurrency and restart. No Commerce/Inventory edits, live payments, account changes, deployment, merge, or duplicate review.

alternatives: Add an authenticated Commerce reconcile wake URL once Commerce exposes a caller; keep events as wakes only.
Queue Inventory whole-basket reserve/release after ownership and this adapter's review are confirmed.

data.recommended: Refresh Commerce compatibility after the owner finishes CheckoutPaymentPort equality repair, then authorize review of this uncommitted adapter.
